plan.title: feat(design-critique): parent-side substantiation for evidence introduced while adjudicating; unaudited premises block bind

narratives.Description: Parent artifacts that adjudicate critic findings introduce load-bearing premises that nothing currently binds. The bound design (successor lean 5388344109) is a three-part state machine: substantiation at the point of use, independence clearance by a later critic, and unresolved markers blocking verified-synthesis bind. #3640 already shipped, so this story also writes the composed auto-bind conjunct (all-accept map AND zero unresolved audit markers) at both Operator-verbs :150 and Bind path 1 :209.
narratives.Overview: Bound source of truth is successor lean 5388344109, not the as-filed four-obligation body. Wave-order note: umbrella #3434 current-shape pass-1 listed this as wave 3 after #3657/#3660/#3661; operator overrode that order and started a fresh swarm on #3651 first. #3640 is merged, so this story carries the §4 composed auto-bind amendment. Line anchors drifted after PR #3658: verification rules now :193-195, slim walk :130, dual-stop :166. Shared file content/contracts/design-critique.md is contended with open #3657, #3660, #3661 — this cohort is N=1; do not parallel those later without sequencing. Detection (§5) remains an open design input that the implementer must choose and test; omission must have a failure mode.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, design, process, area:skills, status:child, design-critique:triage-ready
narratives.UserStory: As a parent after a critic panel, I want premises I introduce while adjudicating to carry a SHA, pointer, and measured-versus-asserted token, so that unaudited parent readings cannot auto-bind synthesis.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add a short ADR under docs/decisions/ that records the principle and its three refusals (parent adjudicating artifacts are arbitration surfaces; primary-source citation is not independent clearance; the parent cannot self-clear). 2. Edit content/contracts/design-critique.md as sole normative protocol: substantiation shape, independence predicate, unresolved markers as residual, composed auto-bind conjunct at both :150 and :209, slim walk comments at the drifted :130. 3. Update content/templates/design-critique-brief.md and content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json. 4. Pin each MUST in packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/design_critique_contract.test.ts and add a verifier test that fails on omission. 5. Implement the chosen detection surface so a missing token, silently cleared marker, or envelope that omits a target has a failure mode. 6. Add a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line. Bound SoT: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3651#issuecomment-5388344109. Staleness addendum 5389126648 (line drift after #3658).
narratives.LockedDecisions: Successor lean 5388344109 is bound SoT. Synthesis accepted 5388421874. Staleness addendum 5389126648 is bookkeeping, not a recut. Out of scope: dual-stop cap default, auto-dispatch #3578, widening judgmentGates, critics adjudicating each other, round-3+ ceiling (#3660), relaxing variant-table :38 (#3657). Vehicle: both a new ADR and contract MUST/transition edits.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Nine acceptance clauses match the bound issue checklist (successor lean 5388344109 plus §4 composition after #3640 landed). They exceed the 2-5 swarm default because each obligation is independently pin-testable.

items.title: Section 1 substantiation token is recorded at the point of use

narrative.When: When a role:parent artifact introduces a load-bearing premise while adjudicating, it records dispatch SHA, source pointer, and measured-versus-asserted at that point, and walk comments stay a token plus pointer.
narrative.Acceptance: When a role:parent artifact introduces a load-bearing premise while adjudicating, it records dispatch SHA, source pointer, and measured-versus-asserted at that point, and walk comments stay a token plus pointer.

narrative.When: When a section-1 premise changes classification, residual, or next-build contract, it stays unaudited until a later role:critic artifact targets its marker; parent self-clearance and mixed-basis laundering are rejected.
narrative.Acceptance: When a section-1 premise changes classification, residual, or next-build contract, it stays unaudited until a later role:critic artifact targets its marker; parent self-clearance and mixed-basis laundering are rejected.

narrative.When: When an audit marker is unresolved, verified-synthesis bind is blocked and the marker is residual; promising a later pass does not discharge it.
narrative.Acceptance: When an audit marker is unresolved, verified-synthesis bind is blocked and the marker is residual; promising a later pass does not discharge it.

items.title: Section 4 composed auto-bind conjunct on both sites

narrative.When: When auto-bind runs, both Operator-verbs auto-stamp and Bind-after-accepted-synthesis path 1 require an all-accept disposition map AND zero unresolved audit markers.
narrative.Acceptance: When auto-bind runs, both Operator-verbs auto-stamp and Bind-after-accepted-synthesis path 1 require an all-accept disposition map AND zero unresolved audit markers.

items.title: Section 5 detection has a failure mode

narrative.When: When a token is omitted, a marker is silently cleared, or an envelope omits a named audit target, a verifier or content-contract test fails closed rather than only pinning rule text.
narrative.Acceptance: When a token is omitted, a marker is silently cleared, or an envelope omits a named audit target, a verifier or content-contract test fails closed rather than only pinning rule text.

narrative.When: When walk comments are posted, they stay slim per the drifted contract line :130; substantiation lives in the parent artifact or linked successor lean.
narrative.Acceptance: When walk comments are posted, they stay slim per the drifted contract line :130; substantiation lives in the parent artifact or linked successor lean.

items.title: ADR records principle and three refusals

narrative.When: When docs/decisions/ contains the new ADR, it records that parent adjudicating artifacts are arbitration surfaces, primary-source citation is not independent clearance, and the parent cannot self-clear.
narrative.Acceptance: When docs/decisions/ contains the new ADR, it records that parent adjudicating artifacts are arbitration surfaces, primary-source citation is not independent clearance, and the parent cannot self-clear.

narrative.When: When design_critique_contract tests run, they pin each drafted MUST and include a verifier case that fails on omission.
narrative.Acceptance: When design_critique_contract tests run, they pin each drafted MUST and include a verifier case that fails on omission.

narrative.When: When CHANGELOG.md is read, [Unreleased] contains one brief release-notes line for this story.
narrative.Acceptance: When CHANGELOG.md is read, [Unreleased] contains one brief release-notes line for this story.
